connector.name: Signs of AI Writing
connector.registryDescription: Bilingual (EN/ES) AI-writing detection that shows the evidence, plus originality checking.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the NuGet package SignsOfAI.Mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the peopleworks account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SIGNSOFAI_API_ENDPOINT
env.description: Base URL of the SignsOfAI API used by the two optional server-backed tools (measure_predictability, check_paraphrase). Defaults to the PeopleWorks-hosted endpoint. The four analysis tools never call it.
